title: Introduce environment-aware Helm templating and sequential init-guard hooks
author: Aisha Clarke
release_notes: Add environment-aware Helm template helpers; introduce a sequential init-guard job to enforce ordered tenant bootstrap; new values.schema.json fields for environment and initGuard settings; migration hooks gain dry-run and staged windows. No breaking changes; rollout safe behind feature gate in values.
description: Context and motivation: Private installs in multi-environment (dev/staging/prod) have repeatedly required ad-hoc chart patches to tune resources, node affinity, and init ordering. This PR centralizes environment-specific template branching and introduces a sequential init-guard mechanism to make tenant bootstrap and migration hooks deterministic and idempotent across clusters. Summary of changes: 1) new chart helper functions (templates/_helpers.tpl) and an explicit values.environment field (dev|staging|prod) that drives resource profiles, tolerations, and nodeAffinity snippets; 2) values.schema.json extended with typed buckets for environment and initGuard configuration (timeouts, concurrency, retries); 3) a small controller-less init-guard implemented as a Kubernetes Job (templates/init-guard-job.yaml) that acquires a ConfigMap-backed lease and enforces sequence numbers; 4) migration hook jobs updated to honor a staged window and a dryRun flag to allow preflight run without mutating state; 5) NOTES and tests added to demonstrate how to enable env overlays and the init-guard feature. Checklist: - [x] Add values.schema.json and validate with helm schema test - [x] Implement helpers and unit tests for templating - [x] Add init-guard job + tests - [x] Add migration hook dry-run option and phased window - [x] Run integration tests on k8s:dev, k8s:staging - [x] CI lint/helm lint passed Design decisions and tradeoffs: the init-guard is intentionally implemented as a simple Job-based mutex rather than an operator to avoid a new controller dependency in the private-installer bundle; it uses a short-lived ConfigMap lease pattern that is compatible with air-gapped clusters. Environment-aware templates are explicit (values.environment) instead of inferring from cluster labels to keep behavior deterministic and user-controlled. Rollout and fallback: default for values.environment is "dev". The init-guard feature is gated by values.initGuard.enabled=false by default to avoid surprises for existing customers. To roll this out we will: 1) release this chart change behind a documented opt-in values flag; 2) update private-installer upgrade notes; 3) run a canary upgrade in staging for two tenants; 4) after 48h, enable broadly. Backwards compatibility: templates are guarded so existing values files without the new keys continue to render with prior defaults. Security: lease mechanism requires no new RBAC beyond Chart's existing ServiceAccount roles. Manual testing instructions: - Install chart with --set initGuard.enabled=true --set environment=staging - Observe that templates render the staging resource profile via helm template - Apply chart and watch the init-guard job acquire and release the ConfigMap lease in sequence - Run migration hook with --set migration.dryRun=true to verify non-mutating path Notes: this description is a single continuous string (no multi-field sections).

review_comments: Jordan Patel: Could we make the lease ConfigMap name configurable so multi-tenant controllers in the same namespace don't collide? Also request an optional timeout override per-tenant.

Author (Aisha): Added initGuard.leaseName and initGuard.perTenantTimeout to values.schema (default null). Updated templates to use .Values.initGuard.leaseName | default chart .Release.Name. Added doc snippet in NOTES.

Lina Weiss: Tests look good. One concern: the Job retry backoffLimit currently set to 6 may hide persistent failures. Suggest surface an alert via a job-failure annotation that the console can scrape.
Author (Aisha): Added job annotations 'redwood.com/init-guard-failure: true' and reduced backoffLimit to 3. Documented in NOTES and added test to assert annotation presence.
Tomoko Hayashi: Approving — verified smoke on staging cluster; init sequence required for tenant bootstrap ordering works as expected. CI green.
notes_on_backward_compatibility: All new behavior is opt-in via values.initGuard.enabled and values.environment. Existing values files render with previous defaults and chart will not enable init-guard unless set. Migration job changes are additive: dryRun=false defaults preserve prior behavior.
testing_notes: Local validation: helm lint + helm template with different environments. CI: chart-tests run in k8s:kind matrix; integration smoke verified on staging cluster. Manual validation steps included in NOTES.txt and PR description.
changelog_entry: Feature: environment-aware templates and opt-in sequential init-guard job for deterministic tenant bootstrap (private-installer chart)
